studies.title: Coffee consumption and sleep quality in healthy adults: a randomized crossover trial
studies.abstract: We randomized 40 healthy human adults to caffeine versus placebo and measured sleep onset latency. Caffeine increased latency in humans.

studies.title: Effect of evening coffee on polysomnography in older adults
studies.abstract: A double-blind RCT in human participants (n=55) found reduced slow-wave sleep after evening coffee.

studies.title: Caffeine and subjective sleep in adolescents
studies.abstract: Cross-sectional human survey (n=320) linking daily coffee intake to poorer sleep quality.

studies.title: A systematic review of caffeine effects on sleep
studies.abstract: We review the literature on coffee and sleep. This is a review article, not a primary trial.

studies.title: Coffee and locomotor activity in rats
studies.abstract: We administered caffeine to rats and measured activity; no human subjects were studied.

studies.title: Coffee and cardiovascular risk in humans
studies.abstract: Longitudinal human cohort on coffee and heart disease; sleep was not assessed.

studies.title: Kaffee und Schlafqualität bei Erwachsenen
studies.abstract: Eine Beobachtungsstudie über Kaffee und Schlaf in Deutschland.

studies.title: Editorial: should we warn patients about coffee?
studies.abstract: An editorial commentary on caffeine guidance.
